title: Does Reasoning Improve Psychological Depth in Large Language Models?
abstract: arXiv:2611.09061v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Benchmark gains from reasoning-enhanced large language models encourage the assumption that these models should broadly perform better on complex generative tasks, but this remains underexplored in open-ended, creative domains shaped by nuances of reader experience. We tested this assumption through the lens of psychological depth in short stories. We compared DeepSeek-R1 vs. DeepSeek-V3, our closest available contrast for reasoning-oriented post-training, and GPT-5 vs. GPT-4o, through 60 blinded pairwise evaluations in which seven human annotators and an ensemble LLM-as-a-Judge rated prompt-matched story outputs. Human evaluations showed no universal reasoning advantage: GPT-5 was slightly preferred over GPT-4o (60.0-62.9% across two reasoning-effort settings), whereas DeepSeek-R1 fell behind DeepSeek-V3 (42.9%). translated_title: 推理能力能否提升大语言模型的心理深度？
translated_abstract: 推理增强型大语言模型在基准测试上的成绩提升，促使人们假设这些模型在复杂生成任务上应普遍表现更佳，但在受读者体验细微差别影响的开放式创意领域，这一假设仍未得到充分探索。我们通过短篇小说的心理深度这一视角检验了该假设。我们比较了DeepSeek-R1与DeepSeek-V3（这是可获得的最接近的面向推理的后训练对比组合），以及GPT-5与GPT-4o，通过60次盲测成对评估，由七名人类标注员和一个集成LLM-as-a-Judge对提示匹配的故事输出进行评分。人类评估显示推理能力并无普遍优势：GPT-5略优于GPT-4o（在两种推理努力设置下为60.0-62.9%），而DeepSeek-R1则落后于DeepSeek-V3（42.9%）。尽管这一结果伴随着较低的标注员间一致性（Krippendorff's α = 0.070），我们的标注质量控……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 该研究通过盲测成对评估发现，推理增强并不必然提升大语言模型在短篇小说心理深度这类开放式创意写作中的表现，GPT-5仅略优于GPT-4o，而DeepSeek-R1反而落后于非推理版的DeepSeek-V3。
en_tdlr: Through blinded pairwise human evaluations of short stories, this study shows that reasoning enhancement does not confer a universal advantage in psychological depth, with GPT-5 only slightly preferred over GPT-4o while DeepSeek-R1 underperforms DeepSeek-V3.
